summary: E2E retest of Orcamentos module after nested-modal z-index fix (createPortal + z-[100]). All 7 critical flows passed. Live unit_price editing and grand total recalculation work as expected. Save persists, preview renders with R$ format and client name, print button is clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: OrcamentosPage.js is ~800 lines and contains 4 tabs + multiple modals + editor — recommend splitting into separate files (QuotesTab.jsx, ServicesTab.jsx, FreightsTab.jsx, TemplatesTab.jsx, QuoteEditor.jsx, ModalShell.jsx) for maintainability.
ModalShell uses outer onClick={onClose} with stopPropagation on inner — this works, but accessibility is missing (no role='dialog', aria-modal, focus trap, ESC handler). Low priority.

Multiple nested portaled modals all share z-[100] — currently fine because newest is appended last to body. If future code introduces other portals at z-[100], stacking may regress. Consider z-[100], z-[110] hierarchy.
QuoteEditor uses controlled inputs but parseFloat returns 0 for empty string — user clearing a numeric input shows 0 instead of empty. Minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_E2E_Cliente_517520 (client) and quote #11 with item Coleta Residuo Classe I (qty 3 x R$ 99.99) + freight Senador Canedo->Goiania (50km x R$ 2.50). Grand total R$ 424.97 visible in list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40 z-index/portal bug is FULLY FIXED. End-to-end Orcamentos flow validated: login → menu → new quote → catalog pick service (nested modal clickable) → live edit unit_price (R$99.99 x qty3 = R$299.97 in real time on quote-grand-total) → catalog pick freight + km edit → create new client → fill payment terms/method/validity/seller → save → list shows new row → preview renders HTML with R$ format and client name → print-quote-btn visible+enabled. No JS errors. Two quote rows now exist in tenant crmtest. Test catalog data: 2 produtos and 2 fretes already seeded.
rca of the issue: Previous bug (iter40) fixed via createPortal(document.body) for ModalShell + z-[100]. Each nested modal renders to body in DOM order, so the latest (catalog picker) overlays the parent (QuoteEditor) naturally without z-index conflicts. Confirmed clickable via successful pick-service / pick-freight flow.
